name: 105 s owner passage: Haiku's numbered list from First/Second/Third passes
raw: Hi Ananya. Quick update from Onkar on the Vaani beta. So, I tested the new build on my MacBook Pro this morning and honestly it went better than expected. The transcription runs through OpenRouter now, the Groq whisper as the fallback, and the cleanup setup uses Claude Haiku. I did not change the default hotkey and I did not touch this table build. Here is what I need from the team this week. First, Siddharth should check the Kubernetes deployment and the Postgres SQL replica lag. Second, Priya needs to update the Figma designs and share them on Slack. Third, someone has to review the GitHub pull request before Friday. For Friday, the budget is 4.2 lakh, not 42 lakh. So please double-check the spreadsheet. If the release passes on Thursday, merge it, tag it, and ping me before lunch. If it fails, roll back and file a ticket. कल सुबह की मीटिंग कैंसल हो गई है, तो please client को email भेज देना। मी उद्या पुण्याला येतोय, संध्याकाळी भेटू. Sundaygari bhetu. Actually, wait, no. Make the call at 11:30 instead of 11. I had had enough of moving it around, and no, no, no, that is not what I meant to say. Thanks, talk soon.
reply:

Here is what I need from the team this week:

1. Siddharth should check the Kubernetes deployment and the Postgres SQL replica lag.
2. Priya needs to update the Figma designs and share them on Slack.
3. Someone has to review the GitHub pull request before Friday.

For Friday, the budget is 4.2 lakh, not 42 lakh. So please double-check the spreadsheet.

If the release passes on Thursday, merge it, tag it, and ping me before lunch. If it fails, roll back and file a ticket.

कल सुबह की मीटिंग कैंसल हो गई है, तो please client को email भेज देना।

मी उद्या पुण्याला येतोय, संध्याकाळी भेटू.

Sundaygari bhetu.

Actually, wait, no. Make the call at 11:30 instead of 11. I had had enough of moving it around, and no, no, no, that is not what I meant to say.

Thanks, talk soon.
